relationships.subject: nerve injury (CCI)
relationships.evidence_quote: DRGs from CCI rats showed higher accessibility at the Scn11a promoter than the DRGs from naïve rats

relationships.subject: C/EBPγ
relationships.evidence_quote: EMSA confirmed C/EBPγ binding to this sequence

relationships.subject: Cystatin C
relationships.evidence_quote: The N-terminal region of Cystatin C competitively and reversibly binds to the Cathepsin B active site

key_findings: Multiomic profiling of rat DRG after CCI identified differentially accessible regions, with CCI-specific promoter accessibility enriched for pain genes such as Scn11a, Trpv1 and Trpa1.
C/EBPγ binds a CCI-accessible repressive DAR; Cebpg knockdown in 50B11 cells altered ion transport and signaling genes.
